items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had done some dates with this violinist... whether you are talking about Shep Smith

ctx.x: Then you do a recording, I think it was called—It’s called “Club New Yorker.” You used a violin player named…

Oh, that violin player. I had done some dates with this violinist, some recording dates. He seemed to be very fluent. He was a good player. Most of violinists are not great jazz players whether you are talking about Shep Smith, or… Who is the other great jazz violinist? There are not too many.
